title: judge_scores_v0
description: Strict per-item LLM-judge score row. Dimensions match the human study (overall_suitability, vocabulary_accessibility, syntax_accessibility, answer_adequacy) on integers 1–4. No provider fields. additionalProperties is false.

notes.description: Optional free-text; never replaces numeric scores

judge_id.description: Optional opaque judge run label (not a provider SDK id)

rubric_version.description: Must be beginner_suitability_judge_rubric_v0 (or matching human rubric version)
